+    /// Background-only read/clear review shares the original publication barrier with bind.
+    pub(crate) fn with_storage_management<T>(
+        &self,
+        operation: impl FnOnce(&nxtools_extensions::storage::StorageOwner) -> anyhow::Result<T>,
+    ) -> anyhow::Result<T> {
+        let _publication = self
+            .publication

+            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("extension publication unavailable"))?;
+        let storage = self
+            .storage
+            .as_ref()
+            .ok_or(nxtools_extensions::storage::StorageError::Unavailable)?;
+        operation(&storage.owner)
+    }
